picks.headline: Relay Market Powers Discount LLM Token Reselling via Exploited API Keys
picks.why: Uncovers a thriving shadow ecosystem reselling stolen token quota and API keys, posing financial and security risks to application providers.
picks.title: An Inside Look at the Relay Market Powering Token Resellers and Fraud

picks.headline: SPORE Attack Exfiltrates Private Long-Term Memory from Isolated LLM Agents
picks.why: Demonstrates the first persistent memory extraction attack that leverages tool interfaces to leak private agent data past user isolation boundaries.
picks.title: Isolated but Exposed: Persistence-Based Memory Extraction Attack on LLM Agents

picks.headline: TriShieldRAG Cuts RAG Knowledge Corruption Attack Success to 13 Percent
picks.why: Introduces a practical three-stage defense pipeline combining ingestion screening, re-ranking, and cross-LLM consensus to protect enterprise retrieval systems.
picks.title: TriShieldRAG: A Three-Ring Defense-in-Depth Framework Against Knowledge Corruption in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

picks.headline: Apple Unveils Memory-Efficient On-Device Audio Transformer with 16x Real-Time Streaming
picks.why: Achieves constant memory complexity for high-quality streaming audio synthesis on edge devices.
picks.title: Memory Efficient Audio Synthesis with Decoupled Temporal Depth Diffusion Transformers

picks.headline: Kalypso Framework Enables Relational Query Optimization and KV-Cache Reuse in LLMs
picks.why: Structuring LLM serving requests as relational queries allows automatic pipeline execution and cross-query KV-cache sharing.
picks.title: Kalypso: Relational LLM Serving

papers.headline: Spectral Law Accurately Predicts Catastrophic Forgetting in LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.why: Proves mathematically that intruder dimensions in low-rank weights cause catastrophic forgetting, giving engineers an exact threshold to monitor during fine-tuning.
papers.title: The Intruder Threshold: A Spectral Law for LoRA Fine-Tuning

papers.headline: Task Transformation Generates Self-Verifiable Rewards for Open-Ended LLM Self-Improvement
papers.why: Extends RLVR beyond rigid math and code constraints by mapping open-ended reasoning tasks into verifiable proxy game environments.
papers.title: From RLVR to RLSVR: Task Transformation Induces Self-Verifiable Rewards for Open-Ended LLM Self-Improvement

papers.headline: Chain-of-Thought Unfaithfulness Detection Fails on Incorrect Model Outputs
papers.why: Reveals that behavioral detection tools completely fail on wrong answers, missing 69% of cases where reasoning chains diverge from internal model logic.
papers.title: Two Regimes of Chain-of-Thought Unfaithfulness: Behavioral Detection Fails Where Models Are Wrong
